subject: Assurance onboarding: draft milestones & next steps
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finaro.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@finaro.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Assurance onboarding: draft milestones & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya S.,

Great to meet you both on the call this morning — thanks for walking us through your timeline and constraints. As promised, below is a concise recap + a proposed set of milestones we can include in the mutual action plan (MAP) so everyone has visibility and owners. Please confirm any date or owner changes and we’ll publish the MAP PDF and a shared Drive folder.

High-level objective: Deliver the assurance package required for your security gate so production access can be approved by 2027-08-18.

Proposed milestones (owners & rough SLAs):
- 1) Questionnaire kickoff (Finaro completes initial answers) — owner: Finaro (Priya S.) — due: 2027-07-21
- 2) Redwood initial artifact bundle (controls summary, architecture diagram, data flows) — owner: Marissa (Redwood) — due: 2027-07-28
- 3) Evidence intake sprint (logs, config exports, third-party attestations) — owner: Ben (Redwood) / Finaro SME
  - target window: 2027-07-29 to 2027-08-05
- 4) Joint review & gap list — owner: Priya (Redwood) & Alex (Finaro) — due: 2027-08-09
- 5) Final package handoff + sign-off for gating team — owner: Finaro (Procurement/Legal) — target: 2027-08-18

Dependencies / blockers we called out:
- Procurement: PO or contract signature (Finaro legal) — ideally before 2027-08-09 for uninterrupted access to some artifacts.
- Scoped controls: confirm the systems in-scope for assurance (we noted API endpoints + embeddings pipeline on call).
- Helpful: point person for logs (who can pull IAM, network and audit logs) — call this out when you confirm questionnaire leads.

Attachments: I’m attaching the questionnaire you asked for and a first MAP draft (mutual_action_plan_draft_v1.pdf). I’ll also create a shared Drive folder and add the itemized artifact checklist.

Next steps: Please confirm owners/dates above or reply with edits. If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute follow-up tomorrow to finalize owners.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: Finaro-Security-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_draft_v1.pdf

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finaro.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@finaro.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Mark Chen <mchen@finaro.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance onboarding: draft milestones & next steps

Thanks Priya — good summary. A few quick items from our side: 

- We can hit the 2027-07-21 timeline for the initial questionnaire answers; I’ll make sure Priya S. owns that.
- Procurement (Mark) is looped — we expect to have a PO in the week of 2027-08-02, but I’ll push for earlier if it helps.
- For the evidence intake, our security team can provide logs for the API layer but will need a short runbook from Ben on exact exports needed (format + time windows).

I’ve attached our completed portion of the questionnaire where possible (we filled sections A–C) and placed notes inline where we need clarification. We aim for a 10-business-day turnaround on the items we own.

If Redwood can provide the initial artifact bundle by 7/28 (diagram + controls summary + example config exports), that will let our security engineers start mapping. Good to align on a joint review on 8/9.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Head of Security, Finaro Financial
alex.gomez@finaro.com

Attachment stub: Finaro-Security-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx (annotated)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finaro.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@finaro.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance onboarding: draft milestones & next steps

Appreciate the quick turn, Alex — that works. I’ve attached the MAP draft as a PDF (mutual_action_plan_draft_v1.pdf) which enumerates milestones, owners, acceptance criteria and the tentative target close date (2027-08-18). Below is the same set of milestones with specific Redwood artifact owners so your team knows who to ping.

Redwood artifact owners (for our internal tracking):
- Controls summary + architecture diagram (including dataflow & privileged paths) — Marissa Cole — due 2027-07-28
- SRE / infra artifacts (example K8s manifests, autoscale config, KV cache retention notes) — Ben Carter — due 2027-07-28
- Legal / contract answers (data residency, subprocessor list) — Rishi Malhotra — due 2027-07-25
- Evidence intake coordinator (single point for uploads & Q&A) — Priya Natarajan (i.e., me) — ongoing through 2027-08-05

I’ll create the Drive folder and drop a CSV checklist (artifact name, owner, desired format, deadline). Marissa / Ben / Rishi — please confirm you can meet the dates or flag any blockers by EOD.

Forwarding original questionnaire back to you with our suggested responses where applicable.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finaro.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@finaro.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance onboarding: draft milestones & next steps

Thanks — I’ve reviewed the MAP draft and added a short artifact hotlist below (I’ll also upload as redwood-assurance-artifact-list.zip into the Drive folder). Quick notes on what we can provide immediately and what will require a short runbook / export window.

Immediate (can deliver 7/28):
- Architecture diagram (png + Visio) — includes network segments and VPC/subnet IDs
- Controls summary (docx) — mapping to common frameworks (access control, patching, change management)
- Example config exports (anonymized) for two representative services (tar.gz)

Needs runbook / export window (plan 7/29–8/05):
- IAM audit logs (one-week slice, JSONL) — Ben to coordinate with Finaro security on format
- Network flow logs (sample window) — requires temporary access or secure transfer
- Third-party attestations & vendor list (PDFs) — available immediately, will be bundled

A couple of asks for Finaro to speed the intake:
- Confirm the log time window you want for the initial intake (we suggest 7/01–7/07 as representative)
- Share SFTP details or Drive upload permissions for large exports

I’ll attach the controls summary and a short README for the config export format into the Drive folder by EOD 7/14.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com

Attachment stubs: redwood-assurance-artifact-list.zip, controls-summary.docx

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finaro.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <psingh@finaro.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Mark Chen <mchen@finaro.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance onboarding: draft milestones & next steps

All clear from our side. We confirm:
- Questionnaire answers by 2027-07-21 (Priya S.).
- Expecting Redwood artifact bundle 2027-07-28.
- Logs export window: 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-07 as Marissa suggested.
- Procurement: aiming for PO week of 2027-08-02; will update if earlier.

Please send the DocuSign link for the finalized MAP/quote once you’re ready and we’ll prioritize signature. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Head of Security, Finaro Financial
